correctness.rationale: The oscillator ODE and Rodrigues formulas yield normalized nonzero even boundary values and odd derivatives. Green/Wronskian identity yields B_{ab}=u_a v_b/(2b+1-2a) for the centered half-line compression; parity kills same-parity centered blocks. Every maximal minor of this scaled rectangular Cauchy matrix is nonzero. Singular-value pairing and Cauchy–Binet prove the all-mask multiplicity and exact gap product. For consecutive even lowpass indices, direct determinant-ratio calculation and the gamma duplication formula give the exact finite product. The Barnes G recurrence and standard asymptotic expansion give the m^-1/4 limit and constant. Independent finite numerical quadrature and 2036 mask checks corroborate but are not used as infinite proof.

The most plausible alternate Gaussian-sign-jump formulation is explicitly checked; the classical asymptotic theorems require |Re beta|<1/4, excluding beta=1/2, and their scope does not contain finite arbitrary-index Hermite masks.
